📺 9-1-1: Lone Star (2020–2025)

9-1-1: Lone Star follows Owen Strand, an experienced New York City firefighter who relocates to Austin, Texas, with his son T.K. after being recruited to rebuild Firehouse 126 following a devastating tragedy. Determined to create a strong and dedicated team, Owen brings together a diverse group of firefighters and paramedics, each with their own unique personalities, backgrounds, and personal struggles. Alongside paramedic captain Tommy Vega, police officer Carlos Reyes, and emergency dispatcher Grace Ryder, the team responds to terrifying accidents, natural disasters, dangerous fires, and extraordinary emergencies that constantly put their lives at risk. Beyond their demanding careers, the first responders navigate complicated relationships, family conflicts, health challenges, and emotional hardships while developing an unbreakable bond. Starring Rob Lowe, Ronen Rubinstein, Gina Torres, Rafael Silva, Sierra McClain, and Jim Parrack, the series delivers thrilling action, heartbreaking moments, unforgettable rescues, and powerful storytelling about courage, sacrifice, friendship, love, and the importance of standing together during life’s most difficult moments.

🎭 Genre: Action • Drama • Thriller • Procedural

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk & Tim Minear

📺 Seasons: 5 • 72 Episodes

📚 Based On: A spin-off of the popular television series 9-1-1 (2018–Present).

📍 Setting: Austin, Texas, primarily following the first responders of Firehouse 126.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu (United States)

source_details.synopsis: 9-1-1: Lone Star is an American procedural drama television series that aired on Fox from January 19, 2020, to February 3, 2025. Created by Ryan Murphy, Brad Falchuk, and Tim Minear, the series is a spin-off of the American procedural drama television series 9-1-1, and was ordered by Fox in May 2019. In May 2023, the series was renewed for a fifth and final season, which premiered on September 23, 2024, and concluded on February 3, 2025.
